About me关于我

I am a Media and Communication graduate with a minor in Applied Psychology, now studying MA Digital Media, Culture and Society at The University of Manchester. My experience moves between automotive communication, event content, newsroom reporting and campus engagement. I enjoy asking what people need to understand first, then building the clearest route from message to action.

我拥有媒体与传播学背景，辅修应用心理学，目前就读于曼彻斯特大学数字媒体、文化与社会硕士。我的经历覆盖汽车传播、赛事内容、新闻采编与校园活动。我习惯先理解人们真正需要知道什么，再寻找从信息到行动最清晰的路径。

How I work工作方法

01

Read the audience理解受众

Research, interviews and close attention to what people need to understand.从研究、访谈与现场观察中判断受众真正需要什么。

02

Shape the story组织表达

Scripts, briefs, reporting and video — each with a clear purpose.脚本、Brief、报道或视频，每一种形式都有明确目的。

03

Carry it through推进落地

Responding to changing conditions, feedback and the work around a live moment.在现场变量、反馈与发布节奏中，把工作推进到完成。

VOYAH | Two Different Communication Tasks岚图｜两种不同的传播任务

FREE+ pre-sale livestreamFREE+ 预售直播发布会

Work & result工作与成果

  • Role: Contributed to pre-launch copy, the livestream script, a media brief and a rain contingency plan. During the event, I tracked communication data and helped prepare the review.参与工作：预热文案、直播脚本、媒体 Brief 和雨天预案；直播期间监测传播数据，之后协助整理复盘材料。
  • Team result: By 25 July, the overall launch campaign recorded 810M+ reads and 4.06B+ impressions.团队结果：截至 7 月 25 日，上市传播项目整体实现 8.1 亿+阅读、40.6 亿+曝光。

What I learned判断与经验

  • A script has to work on site. For an outdoor test, we had to consider weather, filming positions, equipment and possible changes to the interview. Writing a clear line was only part of the job; the sequence also had to remain workable if conditions changed.脚本要经得起现场检验。户外测试要考虑天气、机位、设备和访谈调整。文字写清楚只是一步，条件变化时还能不能拍、能不能继续讲清楚，同样重要。
  • A brief needs usable angles. Price, comparisons, a guest’s reaction and a visible test offered different ways into the story. In media discussions, I learned to consider what an outlet could actually publish while keeping product details and the brand’s core message accurate.Brief 要给媒体可用的角度。价格、竞品、嘉宾反应和现场测试各有不同新闻切口。与媒体沟通时，我开始同时考虑对方能否写成稿，以及产品信息和品牌核心表达是否准确。

President Lu Fang’s road-trip vlog — post-release communication卢放总自驾 Vlog｜发布后的传播

Work & result工作与成果

  • Role: Worked on commissioned coverage, checked copy before publication and reviewed published media content. I also carried out public-response monitoring as part of the department’s work. The original vlog was produced separately.执行工作：参与约稿，审核发布前稿件及发布后见刊内容；按部门安排执行舆论反馈监测。Vlog 原片由其他团队制作。
  • Team result: By 23 June, the post-release campaign recorded 87.39M+ reads and 430M+ impressions.团队结果：截至 6 月 23 日，发布后传播项目整体实现 8739 万+阅读、4.3 亿+曝光。
87.39M+8,739万+ reads8,739万+ 阅读

What I learned判断与经验

  • Publication is a checkpoint. A piece of coverage still needs follow-up after it goes live: whether the title, key facts and framing match the agreed direction, and whether feedback calls for a correction or escalation.发布不是终点。见刊后仍需核对标题、事实与选题方向；发现偏差或反馈时，及时沟通修改或上报。
  • Editorial interests require discussion. When an outlet preferred a different angle, I learned to discuss a workable version within the brand image and core product requirements, instead of treating the first draft as final.媒体有自己的写作角度。当对方的切入点与原计划不同，我需要在品牌形象和核心卖点要求内沟通出可写的版本，而不是把初稿当作最终答案。

All figures are team results, not individual metrics. Only public posters and permitted, redacted excerpts are shown; internal files, media lists and costs are not published.所有数据均为团队结果，不是个人业绩。仅展示公开海报及经许可、脱敏后的局部；不公开原始工作文件、媒体名单和费用明细。

Harbin Roller Skating Association | Event Content and Official Channels哈尔滨市轮滑协会｜赛事内容与官方账号

Work & result工作与成果

  • Filmed and edited 20+ event videos, interviewed skaters, wrote video scripts and contributed to all linked WeChat articles. I also worked across the association’s official channels, with the WeChat Official Account and Video Account carrying much of the event information and video output.拍摄剪辑 20 余条赛事视频，采访轮滑选手，撰写视频脚本；所列公众号文章均参与撰写。同时参与协会官方账号运营，微信公众号和视频号主要承载赛事信息及视频内容。
  • The work covered the Roller Skating Marathon World Cup, the China Roller Skating Marathon Open in Harbin and related activities. The linked articles serve as writing samples; channel figures are not presented as my individual results.内容覆盖轮滑马拉松世界杯、中国轮滑马拉松公开赛哈尔滨站等活动。公众号链接作为文字作品，不把账号整体数据表述为个人业绩。

What I learned判断与经验

  • One event needs more than one kind of content. Before a race, people need clear practical information; during it, an athlete’s action or reaction can make the event tangible; afterwards, a recap gives participants something to revisit. I learned to choose footage and copy for each of those uses.同一场赛事，不同阶段需要不同内容。赛前信息要准确易找；赛中可以用运动员的动作和反应呈现现场；赛后回顾则让参与者留下可重看的记录。我开始按内容的实际用途选择文字和镜头。
  • Editing means choosing. With repeated action from the same venue, adding more clips does not necessarily make a stronger video. A recognisable person, a complete movement and a short reaction can tell the story more clearly.剪辑的重点是取舍。同一场地有大量相似动作，增加镜头未必更有效。一位具体的人、一个完整动作和一句现场反应，有时更能让观众理解比赛。

Links to the WeChat articles I co-wrote: to be added.参与撰写的公众号文章链接：待补。

What I learned判断与经验

  • A timely topic still needs a clear question. I learned to decide what readers needed in the opening, which facts required checking and which detail was better shown in the video.有时效性的题目，也要有清楚的问题。我需要判断导语先交代什么、哪些事实要核实、哪些细节更适合用画面呈现。
  • The medium changes the edit. An interview quote can carry a written story, while a place or a person’s action may be clearer on screen. I became more deliberate about what to write and what to film, rather than repeating the same information twice.文字与视频不必重复。引语能推动文字报道，地点和动作有时由视频呈现更直接。实习让我更有意识地决定什么值得写、什么值得拍。

Graduation Report | In-home Bathing Assistance毕业报道｜上门助浴服务

Work & result工作与成果

  • Co-authored with Li Zimeng. We researched the market, interviewed sources and wrote a 20-page English longform report on in-home bathing assistance for older people with disabilities. My main responsibilities were proposing the topic, finding interviewees and laying out the text and images.与李子萌共同完成。我们一起做市场调研、采访和新闻写作，形成一篇 20 页的英文长篇报道，探讨失能老人上门助浴服务。我主要负责提出选题、寻找采访对象、图文排版。照片及报道的具体署名沿用 PDF 原文。
  • The report moves from one home visit to the practical and structural questions behind the service: privacy, safety, price, workers’ conditions and family care. The original PDF retains the individual photo and reporting credits.报道由一次上门服务展开，延伸到隐私、安全、价格、从业者处境和家庭照护等问题。

Read the full report (20 pages)阅读完整报道（20 页）

20 pages · scroll to read the full report共 20 页 · 向下滚动阅读完整报道

What I learned判断与经验

  • Scale is not access. A large estimate of potential need says little about whether a family knows the service exists, can afford it or can trust someone to enter the home. That gap between demand and access became one of the questions I wanted the report to hold open.需求规模不等于服务可及。潜在需求数字很大，却不能说明一个家庭能否知道、负担或信任这项服务。需求与实际获得服务之间的距离，是我希望报道继续追问的问题。
  • A scene needs reporting behind it. The opening visit makes the subject concrete; interviews about cost, labour and safety keep the story from resting on emotion alone. I learned to connect an intimate experience with the system around it.现场故事需要调查支撑。开头的上门场景让读者看见具体的人；价格、劳动与安全问题的采访，让报道不只停留在情绪上。我学到的是把个人经验放回支撑它的行业环境。
